name: ic-more-qualities
title: IndustrialCraft - More Qualities
author: mimic
description: Adds 40 new qualities. Paranoidal extension: five defect qualities that early handcrafted and machine-made products and drills may get, and ten quality-control research levels that phase them out; a refinement workshop that repairs defects with repair packs, production modes for assembling machines and furnaces, a control post for production orders, circuit signals and a quality-control panel. See README.md.
